group User.activate [action/User/activate]
  case transition-accepted / transition-accepted
    expect: outcome=accepted; applied-mutations=1; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Active
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/action/User/activate/transition/accepted/from/Confirmed
  case transition-source-rejected / transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Active; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/action/User/activate/transition/rejected/from/Active
  case transition-source-rejected / transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Pending; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/action/User/activate/transition/rejected/from/Pending
  case transition-source-rejected / transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Suspended; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/action/User/activate/transition/rejected/from/Suspended

    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/required/email

    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/required/name
  case unique User.email / validation-rejected

    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/feedback
  case navigation / navigation
    expect: navigation.success=page:Users
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/navigation
  case action-transition-accepted / action-transition-accepted
    expect: outcome=accepted; applied-mutations=1; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Suspended
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/transition/accepted/from/Active
  case action-transition-source-rejected / action-transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; feedback=invalid; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Confirmed; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/transition/rejected/from/Confirmed
  case action-transition-source-rejected / action-transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; feedback=invalid; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Pending; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/transition/rejected/from/Pending
  case action-transition-source-rejected / action-transition-source-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; feedback=invalid; enforcement=authoritative; subject/action.state=User.status:Suspended; subject/action unchanged
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend/transition/rejected/from/Suspended

group Users:User.view [page/Users/view/list/User/action/view]
  case roles(admin) / access-allowed
    expect: outcome=allowed; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/view/access/allowed/admin
  case anonymous / access-denied
    expect: outcome=denied; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/view/access/denied/anonymous
  case navigation / navigation
    expect: navigation.target=UserDetail
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/Users/view/list/User/action/view/navigation
